name: Chakra Battlegrounds
desc:
Train & Fight others to become the strongest ninja.
⭐ Please consider liking and favorite the game for future updates.
Next liking milestone: 60K, something special

🖥️ Controls
G - ultimate mode
F - block
Q - dash
Double Dash - throwables
Double Tap W - run
Left Click - punch
B - emote wheel

Game is available on all devices.
